producer: S6 bounded non-role repo-search legacy migration

judgments.subject: structure.role_profile
judgments.conclusion: Repository retrieval is a reusable evidence contract and configured capability consumer, not a logical App Server role; role_profile is therefore absent rather than populated with placeholders.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.repository-intent
judgments.conclusion: The durable orient, find, trace, impact, and audit intents remain provider-neutral; backend-capability material describes configured mechanics and limitations without becoming semantic owner.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.claim-routing
judgments.conclusion: Coverage, pagination, exact-source verification, negative-claim limits, fallback causes, provenance, and limitations remain complete model-facing causal instructions in the generated projection.

judgments.subject: structure.sections.role-boundaries
judgments.conclusion: Repository retrieval supplies evidence only and acquires no mutation, architecture-selection, runtime-validation, adversarial-review, or acceptance authority.
